message.content:
The Camera app is now open and I can see the camera interface with the shutter button. The shutter button is the large circular button in the center of the screen. According to the completion condition, I need to take one photo. The shutter button appears to be at approximately [499, 498] based on the blue circle with the camera icon. I should tap this shutter button to take the photo.
do(action="Tap", element=[499,498])
